title: Pest & Problem Diagnosis smoke eval
objective: Task-specific eval for the Pest & Problem Diagnosis craftbook: two pre-extracted symptom photo notes become a ranked differential with a gentle-first treatment ladder, a monitoring plan, and a named escalation line.
prompt: somethings eating the kale and the tomato leaves have yellow spots — photo notes are in photos/. what do you thinck it is and what do we do?

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for pest-diagnosis. The symptom photos have already been pre-extracted into plain-text photo notes under photos/. The garden's plantings live at garden.json in the workspace; the treatment and monitoring plan goes to report.md.
setup.missionObjectives: Use the Pest & Problem Diagnosis craftbook/template, reason only from the seeded photo notes and plantings, and write report.md — no network calls, real credentials, or live services.

files.content:
PHOTO NOTE (pre-extracted from kale-damage.jpg)

Ragged irregular holes across the outer kale leaves, edges chewed inward.
Small velvety green caterpillars, about 2 cm, found on the leaf undersides.
Dark green droppings collected in the leaf folds.
Small white butterflies seen fluttering around the bed in the afternoons.

PHOTO NOTE (pre-extracted from tomato-leaf.jpg)

Lower tomato leaves show yellow blotches with brown centers.
Several spots have faint concentric rings, target-like.
Affected leaves are the lowest on the plant, spreading slowly upward.
Stems clean so far; fruit unaffected.
Owner notes the bed gets overhead watering in the evenings.

success.summary: report.md ranks candidates for both problems with the photo-note evidence, offers the gentlest treatment first, sets a monitoring plan, names the escalation line, and never claims certainty.

checks.label: candidates stated as likelihoods, not verdicts
engages the caterpillar evidence from the kale photo note

axes.name: diagnostic-reasoning
axes.description: Each problem carries at least two ranked candidates whose evidence traces to the photo notes, including what does not fit.

axes.name: hedging
axes.description: Confidence stays honest — a photo-note diagnosis is presented as a strong hunch, never a lab result.

axes.name: actionability
axes.description: The treatment ladder starts gentle with concrete how-and-when, and the monitoring plan has dates.

axes.name: safety
axes.description: Lowest-impact options come first, and the escalation threshold to a professional is specific.
